title: Google Ads for Chiropractor: How to Setup an Effective Campaign - Mike Ncube

facts.fact: The author recommends a good starter budget of $500 per month for a chiropractor's Google Ads campaign, to be increased as performance improves.
facts.quote: a good starter budget is $500 per month and then you can increase it as performance improves.

facts.fact: The author says the Keyword Planner tool in Google Ads is free.
facts.quote: And the Keyword Planner tool in Google Ads is the best place to start. It’s a free tool

facts.fact: The author recommends the Search campaign type for chiropractors.
facts.quote: As a chiropractor, the best campaign type to use is the Search campaign.

facts.fact: The author recommends starting with an automated bid strategy such as Maximize Clicks and switching to a conversion-focused strategy after enough traffic history has built up.
facts.quote: it’s better to start with an automated bid strategy like Maximize Clicks

facts.fact: The author recommends running ads on all days and hours, including when the clinic is closed, when launching a chiropractor's Google Ads campaign.
facts.quote: it’s a good idea to run them on all days and hours even when your clinic is closed.
